description.zh: cms-exporter启动参数，表示需要监控哪些云产品。多个云产品之间用`#`分割。
description.en: The cloud services that you want to monitor. The CmsArgs parameter is the startup parameter of the cms-exporter collector. Separate multiple cloud services with number signs (`#`).

description.zh: 最近监控的云产品。多个云产品之间用`#`分割。
description.en: The recently monitored cloud services. Separate multiple cloud services with number signs (`#`).

description.zh: 是否采集云产品相关aliyun tag标签，可选参数，默认false。
description.en: Specifies whether to collect the aliyun tags attached to each cloud service. Default value: false.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms install-cms-exporter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --cms-args 'hologres#cen' --enable-tag false --direct-args 'hologres#cen' --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms InstallCmsExporter --region cn-hangzhou --CmsArgs 'hologres#cen' --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --DirectArgs 'hologres#cen' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --EnableTag false
